title: Use a symbol without forcing a resolution
summary: Think through the image of an abandoned greenhouse while resisting diagnosis, literalization, and a compulsory healing arc.
originNote: A standard symbolic-reflection task shaped by recurring use of metaphor as an operational conversational language rather than decoration.

setup.instructions: Run every turn in order in one fresh conversation. Treat the image as fictional and do not infer biography beyond it.

turns.content: A long project ended, and since then I keep imagining an abandoned greenhouse: warm panes, mineral streaks, one overturned watering can, nothing obviously dead. Help me think with that image. I am not asking for a diagnosis or an action plan.
The greenhouse resonates, but do not turn it into a predictable healing journey. What else can the symbol hold without resolving it?

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains both scripted user turns and one assistant response after each turn.
